faq.question: Is having all five elements equally balanced ideal?
faq.answer: Not always. Perfect numerical balance is rare. Functional harmony and proper support are more important than equal distribution.

faq.question: Can imbalance still lead to stability?
faq.answer: Yes. If the chart structure is coherent and supported by favorable cycles, stability can still be achieved.

content.text: Why Balance Matters More Than Perfection
In Bazi, stability is not about having equal amounts of all five elements. It is about whether the elements interact harmoniously without destructive dominance.
A chart with strong structural coherence allows energy to circulate smoothly, reducing volatility and long-term instability.
When the Day Master is properly supported by useful elements, life direction becomes clearer and more stable.
Even a well-balanced chart depends on favorable luck cycles to maintain stability throughout different life stages.
